cluster.primary_title: New paradigm of China-US ties empowers global stability, development

items.summary: President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States, held amid complex global shifts and lingering bilateral frictions, yielded solid and implementable consensus to consolidate the strategic framework for dynamic stability in China-US relations. As the highest-level bilateral engagement, head-of-state diplomacy serves as an irreplaceable strategic anchor to manage differences, prevent strategic miscalculations, and foster constructive stability in economic, trade and technological domains.
items.title: Head-of-state diplomacy underpins dynamic stability of China-US ties

items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States is a major act of head-of-state diplomacy taking place at a critical juncture in China-US relations, marking a milestone that builds on the past and opens up the future.
items.title: New paradigm of China-US ties empowers global stability, development

items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States has led to new progress in a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said after Xi wrapped up his US visit on Friday.
items.title: Xi's visit sets right path for China, US to get along, Chinese FM says

items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump reached eight deliverables and understandings during the former's historic state visit, agreeing to build a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability on the basis of respect, fairness and reciprocity, a framework experts say reinforces the foundational principles guiding bilateral ties and injects badly needed certainty and stability to the world.
items.title: What message does the China-US consensus send to the world?
